title: save_tasks Roundtrip
prompt: Write save_tasks(path, tasks) writing JSON (ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), then a test-visible roundtrip: after calling save_tasks("tm_rt.json", tasks) with tasks = [{"text": "viết báo cáo", "done": False}], load_tasks("tm_rt.json") must equal tasks. Print the loaded task count (one line).

tests.name: roundtrip holds
tests.code:
import json as _j
with open("tm_rt.json", encoding="utf-8") as _f:
    _d = _j.load(_f)
assert _d == [{"text": "viết báo cáo", "done": False}], f"got {_d}"
assert printed[0] == "1", f"got {printed}"
assert "ensure_ascii=False" in code, "keep Vietnamese readable"
tests.hint: save with json.dump(..., ensure_ascii=False, indent=2); load and print len().
